build: auth security hardening — phases 2-4, branch auth/security-hardening

features.title: Register no longer reveals whether an email exists
features.description: POST /register answers identically whether the email is new or already taken.
steps: Register a brand-new email: succeeds normally, unaffected by this change
Register an email that already has an account: response status and body shape match some other non-oracle rejection, not a distinct 'already registered' message
FAILURE CASE: grep the response body for the literal string 'already registered' after the fix — must not appear

features.title: Login gives one answer for wrong-password, deactivated, and unknown-email
features.description: The pre-auth response to POST /login must not distinguish a deactivated account from a wrong password or a nonexistent user.
steps: Known email, wrong password -> 401 generic (already correct, unchanged)
Known email, correct password, isActive=false -> SAME 401 generic, not 403 'deactivated'
Known email, WRONG password, isActive=false -> SAME 401 generic (both branches collapse to one)
FAILURE CASE: reintroduce the pre-password-check 403 branch and show a test names the regression, then revert

features.title: The eight remaining 500s stop returning err.message
features.description: GET /profile, PUT /profile, PUT /settings, PUT /password, POST /refresh, GET /sessions, DELETE /sessions/:id, POST /sessions/revoke-all each answer a fixed sentence on 500, matching the pattern already applied to /login, /register and /logout.
steps: For each of the 8 endpoints, force a throw (e.g. a bad DB call) and confirm the response body carries no file path, no query text, no Prisma error shape
console.error still logs the real error server-side for each
The fixed sentence is specific enough to be useful ('Failed to update settings', not a shared generic string) so an operator reading a bug report can tell which endpoint failed

features.title: Gate: server clean, no client change
features.description: tsc, vitest, build all clean in the server workspace; client untouched by this phase.
steps: git diff --stat shows no app/client/* changes

features.title: Refresh-token reuse detection + per-account throttle (A4, A6)
features.description: Detect a replayed (already-rotated) refresh token, revoke the session family, alert. Add a per-account failed-login throttle alongside the existing per-IP one. Needs a RefreshToken schema addition (family/tombstone marker) and a decision on the alert channel.

features.title: Token transport + password policy (A7, A8)
features.description: Decision-gated: localStorage vs httpOnly cookie for tokens; composition-based vs NIST 800-63B password policy.
features.notes: Blocked on user decision. See build-spec.md phase 4.
